# The Rider (Colony Antag)
You are small, patient, cunning and into the eyes of most sensible colonists and marines on this rock, the worst thing that can happen to a person.
Your host isn't your victim, it is your ecosystem. Everything you are - your voice, your reach, your survival - runs through the body you ride. Treat it as fodder and it'll wear you out. Treat it as home and it will carry you far.
## Getting Inside
[bold]Latch Onto Host[/bold] is your whole world in one button, and it reads its target before it commits:
- The [bold]unconscious[/bold] are simply taken. Coiling takes a moment - if they wake or move mid-coil, you miss. - The [bold]awake[/bold] are asked. A thought surfaces in their mind: [italic]something wants in.[/italic] They can open the door or slam it. - The [bold]dead[/bold] can be offered a second chance, if you reach them before anyone else does. A body that accepts you gets up again. It is not quite theirs anymore.
## Grip
[bold]Grip[/bold] is your grip strength, your stamina, and how fast it comes back depends entirely on your host's mood:
- A host who [bold]goes along with you[/bold] refills you quickly. Cooperation feeds the parasite. - A host who [bold]resists[/bold] starves you. Their fighting drains grip while you cling on. When the last of it goes, the host drives you out. - Between hosts, you regenerate slowly on your own.
## Your Tools
- [bold]Latch Onto Host[/bold] - the asking, the taking, the door. - [bold]Coax[/bold] - ease your host's pain and knit their wounds, willing or not. The carrot. - [bold]Sustain[/bold] - the carrot's better half, for willing hosts only. Deeper mending: damage and the wounds beneath it close together. - [bold]Punish[/bold] - the stick. Pain bends a resisting host toward cooperation, and in harm mode it lands twice as hard. A host pushed to the edge can be seized outright. - [bold]Seize[/bold] - take the wheel. Their body moves and they watch from behind their own eyes. Expensive, and remembered. - [bold]Whisper[/bold] - a voice only your host hears. While riding, your own words and radio leave in their voice. - [bold]Psychic Whisper[/bold] - talk to nearby minds directly, even while hidden. - [bold]Manifest[/bold] - leave their body without leaving them. - [bold]Hide[/bold] - under tables, racks, beds. Anything with a top. Small things are invisible until they are not.
## The Bargain
A host who let you in is not a hostage. Powers that [bold]reward[/bold] you only work on willing hosts - pain relief, resilience, a body that runs hot and heals. Their grip refills fastest.
Force gets you a body. Bargaining gets you an ally wearing one. The second one is where the good rounds live.
# Playing Against It
So you saw something: a small red creature scuttled under a table and did not come out, or your friend answered a question in a hissing undertone that was not quite theirs. A parasite wants a head, and yours is on the list.
What holds true about them:
- Their hide shrugs off most things. Fire does not. Burn the little horror. - A surgeon can cut one out of a living host, if the host can hold still that long. - A host who dies throws it off. If someone drops with one inside, watch where it scatters. - It cannot force a waking mind, it persuades and seduces but can easily be refused. Watch your sleeping friends, unconscious or dead alike.
